exceptions.reason: Contract behavior change already merged before policy integration: the replacement reservation guard requires person-confirmed quota_pool_fingerprint instead of self-reported quota_fingerprint. Existing accounts start unconfirmed, so new/reactivated shared-pool holds stop until a person confirms; existing active holds may still release/settle. This is not expand-safe and previous-binary read probes do not prove quota-write compatibility. AEON-415 draft PR #71 exposes this exact-byte exception for coordinator review; owner acceptance of the rollout or a staged follow-up migration is required before release.
